title: Mock mode badge in Atlas sidebar
summary: An amber warning badge appears at the bottom of the Atlas sidebar when NEXT_PUBLIC_LEAFCUTTER_MOCK=1. It shows 'Mock mode' in uppercase tracking text with a pulsing amber dot. The footer status line switches from 'Live · reads the repo on each request' to 'Fixtures · bundled mock data'.

provenance.note: Initial fixture for UXP-552 mock-mode badge drift guard
